stemMd: For all positive $a$ and $b$, which expression is identically equal to $\log_{10}(ab)$?

options.label: A
options.textMd: log base 10 of a divided by log base 10 of b

options.label: C
options.textMd: log base 10 of a plus log base 10 of b

options.label: D
options.textMd: The product of the two logarithms

explanationMd: The product rule is log(ab)=log(a)+log(b) for positive arguments and a common valid base. Positivity ensures both separate logarithms are defined.

distractorRationale.a: This is a change-of-base ratio, not the product rule.
distractorRationale.e: Taking logarithms does not remove their operation this way.
distractorRationale.d: Logarithms turn products into sums, not products.
